runtime_notes: Four painted directions, eight movement directions mapped to these views. Walk phase advances by world distance. Walk cells use torso centering, individual height normalization and no alpha crossfade; original portraits remain idle/fallback. No offline image transformation.

Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Asset: a production-ready transparent RGBA WALK-CYCLE SPRITE ATLAS for an isometric Korean dark Japanese-occult RPG. Exactly 8 columns and 4 rows = 32 full-body sprites. Canvas aspect ratio 2:1 (ideally 2048x1024), all 32 cells identical square size with no separators, labels, margins between cells or UI. Reference is the existing idle atlas: preserve that character's outfit, face, body proportions, painterly pixel-like anime detailing, colors and equipment. Only ONE selected role appears in the entire new atlas.
Row 1: front facing the viewer / screen down. Row 2: strict right profile, facing screen right. Row 3: strict left profile, facing screen left. Row 4: back facing away / screen up. Each row repeats the SAME character and SAME direction 8 times in consecutive phases of one complete seamless natural walk. Columns phases: left heel contact, left weight acceptance, passing, left heel rise/right heel approaching, right heel contact, right weight acceptance, passing, right heel rise/left heel approaching. Opposing arm swing, visible alternation of feet, modest knee flexion, realistic weight transfer, subtle fabric and equipment follow-through. No running, no attacks, no new accessories. No grid lines or written text. The feet ground baseline is exactly 90% down each cell and the torso center is exactly the horizontal center. Consistent body height 78% of cell, head remains nearly level with maximum 1% vertical movement. Keep ALL feet, hands, equipment and head inside each cell, no overlaps between neighboring cells. A complete uniform grid, NOT a collage or character lineup. Transparent empty background, no baked ground shadows.
Selected character: ONLY the FIRST/TOP ROW of the reference, the adult male green-clad gatherer/farmer with woven straw hat, olive short jacket, beige scarf, brown loose trousers, wrapped calves and straw sandals, woven vegetable basket strapped to his back. The basket and hat retain exactly their existing design in every view. No merchants, women or hunters.
